item: The erase makes nothing in the folder it erases, and keys is the app's by its content: a keys folder holding anything else keeps the data folder, said as kept
summary: _resolve names every target without making it (data_dir_path, base/keys, OO_COLUMNAR_DIR or base) where it called data_dir() and custody.signing._keys_dir(), both of which make folders. data_scope.keys_folder_state judges keys by content: a real folder holding only APP_KEY_NAMES (the six key files and the evidence restore marker, each with where it is written) and a real .pending of private copies is the app's; anything else, or a link, is foreign; one that cannot be listed is could-not-check (R798). For a foreign keys the panic erase and the uninstall watcher destroy only the app's key files and private copies (never through a link), leave the rest byte for byte, remove every other entry of the data folder and keep the folder, reported as folder_kept_foreign with kept_items (a count, no names); the UI says 'The data folder was kept because it holds items the app did not create (count: {n}).' or 'The data folder was removed.' x12, and never the 'could not be removed ... by hand' caveat for a folder kept on purpose alone; anything else left at its top is still said as not removed (in the erase and in settle_removed), an unlistable keys gives could-not-check and no count, a keys that is a link gives keys_link and a never-clean result with its own caveat x12, and an app key file or private copy still in a kept or shared keys folder (its unlink failed) gives keys_left (a count) with its own caveat x12 and the app's own exact names of what was left (keys_left_names, translate=no, never another entry); the UI result is never clean while not_removed or keys_left is non-empty, and the watcher says INCOMPLETE for any surviving app key, a .pending link, or a plan without the key list while a keys folder exists. Private-copy names take ASCII digits only. R807 (3): in shared scope too the app's key files go by exact name only, never by suffix (KEY_FORM_SUFFIXES and the watcher's key_suffixes removed), and a private copy only by an exact app key name plus the generated tail, so an operator's foo_ed25519.pem is byte-identical after the erase. The other app folder names still owned by name alone are row 378.
